verdict.rationale: A virtual mailbox SaaS could plausibly offer a natural-language or AI-assistant interface, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes operating the service through taps in a phone app or web portal (open/scan, forward, shred, schedule pickup). There is nothing on natural-language commands or a conversational interface, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404, so no AI-facing surface was found.
